summary: Frontend-only verification completed for desktop layout, sidebar collapse, all curriculum accordions, lesson selection, mobile menu, and mobile overflow.

integration_issues.issue: The hidden desktop Sidebar remains mounted while the mobile Sidebar is open, duplicating curriculum-sidebar, accordion, lesson, brand, and progress data-testid values. Global selectors become strict-mode ambiguous and the DOM does not satisfy the requirement that critical elements have unique testids.

action_items: Render only one Sidebar instance at a time, or scope/uniquify the mobile sidebar testids; verify all data-testid values are unique while the mobile menu is open.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js mounts desktop and mobile Sidebar components concurrently; CSS hides the desktop copy but hidden duplicate controls remain in the DOM and can confuse accessibility tooling and automation.
seed_data_creation: None; all curriculum data is local mock data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop shell, collapse/restore, all three accordion open/close flows, desktop lesson selection, mobile menu open/close, and no horizontal overflow passed. Recheck duplicate testids after the mobile Sidebar rendering is corrected.
rca of the issue: App.js always renders <Sidebar ... /> and additionally renders another <Sidebar mobile ... /> when mobileOpen is true. The first copy is hidden by the mobile CSS but remains mounted, so both copies expose identical data-testid attributes.
